newsitem.title: POLAND: Agros takes 31 percent of meat processor.
newsitem.headline: Agros takes 31 percent of meat processor.

text.p: Polish food trader and producer Agros SA took a 30.5-percent stake in newly created meat-processing firm Pomorski Przemysl Miesny Agros Koszalin SA for 4.3 million zlotys, the company said in a Monday statement.
The main shareholder of the new company is the state treasury, which holds a 49.6-percent stake.

The treasury gained its stake by donating assets from the liquidated meat-processing firm Przedsiebiorstwo Przemyslu Miesnego w Koszalinie. An agricultural development organisation holds 16.3 percent of the new firm and individuals hold 3.6 percent. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
